note: Fair value tagged in US dollars is taken as filed (spec 6.4: as_filed is the global default for amounts in dollars).
Cost tagged in US dollars is taken as filed.
Principal tagged in US dollars is taken as filed.

Principal tagged in another currency is kept as filed, in its own currency (the currency column says which). Its dollar value is the separate field principal_amount_usd. Production does the same: principal_amount stays in the filed currency.
A principal already in dollars: principal_amount_usd equals principal_amount (brief, slice 3 Task 3).
Shares or units tagged with the shares unit are taken as filed.

Share of net assets tagged as a pure number (a fraction) is stored as a percent: times 100. Production stores a percent (docs/reference/schemas.md line 25; pipeline/staging_bdc.py lines 2945-2949). Built early for this field only (seeds/reading_action.csv built_early_for_field); the size exceptions of production (above 0.50, filing-level percent test) are not ported.

A PIK rate tagged as a pure number (pure or utr:Rate) is a fraction: times 100 (production stores a percent). A filed value above 1 is not rescaled by its size: unresolved scale_not_decided (controller ruling, slice 4 Task 3).
A spread tagged as a pure number is a fraction: times 100. A filed value above 1 is unresolved scale_not_decided.
A maturity date read as an ISO date is taken as filed (brief, slice 4 Task 3).
